scenarios.name: paying-the-upkeep-with-a-skipped-draw-still-pays
scenarios.why: The setup drive already pays the first upkeep, skipping its draw. At the next upkeep the Vortex adds another age counter and asks again; choosing to pay and then replacing that draw with Obstinate Familiar's skip still counts the cost as paid, so the Vortex stays and the hand stays empty.
